Peer Assessment Rubric

  • IIIF Manifest Validity (4 pts): The JSON-LD manifest strictly conforms to the IIIF Presentation 3.0 API schema with valid Canvases and Painting annotations.
  • TEI Facsimile Precision (3 pts): The <zone> coordinates accurately map bounding boxes to transcription lines without coordinate mismatch.
  • Critical Reflection (3 pts): The reflection clearly analyzes how the separation of Canvas coordinate space from pixel resolution enables perpetual interoperability.
